title.zh: 机器人运动规划与控制

summary.zh: 示例研究方向：让机器人在复杂环境中可靠地运动、交互与操作。
summary.en: Example research area: reliable robot locomotion, interaction and manipulation in complex environments.

body.zh:

body.en:
